key_catalyst: Brent crude surging above $100/bbl on Iran ceasefire rejection and Houthi tanker attacks, with Trump signaling a major military strike
reasoning: Three high-severity bearish catalysts are converging and escalating: Brent crude broke above $100 with Trump threatening a 'massive attack' on Iran, sweeping new 10-12.5% tariffs on ~60 countries, and Fed September hike odds now ~80%. The market has not absorbed these—QQQ already fell -1.90% on 2026-07-23 as the oil-plus-AI-capex theme built, and the same drivers are still intensifying into today rather than resolving, with only Intel's beat offering a partial offset.
